d: When MacGyver is drawn into a labor dispute between grape growers and laborers, he discovers the growers are spraying illegal chemicals.
After experiencing a 'close encounter' of his own, MacGyver begins an investigation of UFO sightings in a small farming community.
MacGyver uncovers an illegal trading ring dealing in counterfeit baseball memorabilia.
An ex-girlfriend frames MacGyver for her broadcasting magnate husband's murder.
MacGyver fights plans for a housing development in an ecologically delicate area.
MacGyver travels to Turkey in search of Alexander the Great's tomb and the legendary Eye of Osiris.
MacGyver infiltrates a criminal biker gang to help prove a parolee's innocence.
MacGyver goes undercover as a homeless person to investigate the murder of a priest.
Pete Thornton agrees to take on the security of an old friend, political refugee Samantha Lora, but finds he can't do the job alone because of a worsening vision problem. He enlists MacGyver's help.
MacGyver is drawn into a mobster's search for stolen loot while nursing his injured leg at a country bed and breakfast run by two elderly sisters.
Murdoc is orderedto kill MacGyver in order to prove his loyalty to a professional hit squad.
MacGyver is drawn into a territorial dispute between an Indian reservation and an electric power company.
Using their unorthodox methods, the Coltons combine their individual talents to create a team of world-class bounty hunters in this MacGyver spinoff.
MacGyver and Pete Thornton reminisce about past adventures as Pete prepares for eye surgery to treat his Glaucoma.
MacGyver and the Phoenix Foundation are overseeing the security and protection of Delasora during his trial. MacGyver is obsessed with the death of Murdoc and believes that he's still alive.
MacGyver's neighbor Kelly Dobbs overhears a plan to have accountant VictorNesbitt murdered. Victor is an accountant with one of Lyle Knox's holding companies and is planning on exposing the company.
MacGyver picks up his best friend's father to take him to his grandson's Bar Mitzvah and finds himself inadvertently involved in an FBI/CIA mission.
After Prometheus, a crazed arsonist, is responsible for the death of his old friend, MacGyver sets out to solve the mystery of this madman and capture him.
